hooks.text: 新卡牌、遗物与药水让每次登塔策略重组
hooks.excerpt: Adapt to an arsenal of brand new cards, relics, and potions, each offering game-changing possibilities—or dangerous consequences. Climb the Spire with a new and returning cast of characters, each with their own cards, motives, and secrets. No two climbs are ever the same.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 四人合作登塔拥有专属卡牌与团队协同
hooks.excerpt: Brave the ascent on your own, or play with up to 4 players and face the Spire together in the all new co-op mode. Discover multiplayer-specific cards, powerful team synergies, and carry your friends (or get carried) to victory!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 五名角色各有专属卡组动机与隐秘背景
hooks.excerpt: Embark on your quest to Slay the Spire as one of five different characters, some of whom will be familiar to seasoned Slayers and two of whom who are brand new. Discover each character’s unique playstyle, full potential, and secret backstory as you conquer all who stand in their way.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
